title: Context transition on a table with a unique key filters exactly the current row
query: EVALUATE ADDCOLUMNS ( Keyed, "T", CALCULATE ( SUM ( Keyed[Value] ) ) )

source.quote: This, of course, holds true if the table has a primary key that guarantees the absence of duplication.
source.supports: with a primary key there are no duplicated rows, so the transition filters a single row

source.quote: The row context, which contains a single row, is transformed into a filter context that contains the same row.
source.supports: the row context becomes a filter context that contains the same row

derivation: Keyed has the same Name and Value pairs as Dup plus a unique Id (1 to 6). The transition also filters Id, so each row sees only itself: T equals Value.
